headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 23, 2026**
article:
The San Diego Padres fell short in Atlanta, losing 5-6 to the Braves. Chris Sale earned the win for the Braves, pitching 6.0 IP with 11 K and 3 ER. Dominic Smith led the Padres with 1 H, 1 HR, and 3 RBI.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams across the league. The Toronto Blue Jays transferred Addison Barger to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Patrick Corbin was placed on the 15-day injured list with a left teres major strain, while Jonatan Clase was placed on the 10-day injured list with left plantar fasciitis.

Several trades and roster moves were made over the past day. Ron Marinaccio was traded from the San Diego Padres to the Pittsburgh Pirates for future considerations. The Kansas City Royals acquired Nate Pearson from the Houston Astros in exchange for Max Martin. The Los Angeles Dodgers traded for Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies, sending Nick Frasso and Landyn Vidourek in return. The Chicago Cubs acquired Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for Aiden Moffett.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall Short in Atlanta**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres suffered a 5-6 loss to the Atlanta Braves, with Chris Sale earning the win after 6.0 IP, 11 K, and 3 ER. Dominic Smith led the Padres with 1 H, 1 HR, and 3 RBI.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Guardians in 3-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 3-1 win over the Cleveland Guardians, with Patrick Bailey leading the Twins' offense. Bailey's standout performance included a home run, one RBI, and a 1-for-4 batting line.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Rays 3-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 3-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, with Shane Bieber earning the win and Louis Varland securing the save.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Take Down Cardinals 10-6**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a 10-6 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Tyler Locklear leading the offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Brandon Pfaadt earned the win for the Diamondbacks.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays' Addison Barger Shifted to 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays right fielder Addison Barger has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Marinaccio Joins the Bucs**
top_news.summary: Ron Marinaccio has been traded to the Pittsburgh Pirates, marking a new addition to the team's roster. The trade was made with the San Diego Padres in exchange for future considerations.
